@syntax Function Name[type]([In|Out|InOut] parameter[type][= default], ...)
@syntax     statements
@syntax End Function
Declares a function. A type character after the name (`%`, `#`, `$`) or a long type (`Name:Float`) sets what it returns, and parameters are typed the same way. A parameter with `= value` is optional and gets that value when the call leaves it out. [Return](Return) leaves the function, with a value when it has a return type. A parameter is passed by value (`In`, the default); writing `Out` or `InOut` in front of its name makes the function hand its value back to the variable the caller passed, see [Parameter modes](Parameter-Modes). Functions can only be declared outside of other code, they may call each other in any order, and they end with `End Function`. Variables made inside are local to the function; use [Global](Global) for variables that every function sees.

```blitzbasic
;run
Function Area#(w#, h# = 2.0)
	Return w * h
End Function

Print Area(3, 4)
Print Area(5)
```

```text
12.0
10.0
```
